question: Can current runtime/source signature information authoritatively close ClayCode WP04 CallContract obligations without inventing semantic types?

hypothesis.claim: Version-pinned runtime/source signatures can directly originate exact Clay CallContracts for some unresolved calls.

strongest_counterhypothesis.claim: Runtime/source annotations can validate compatibility with a prior explicit Clay semantic contract, but cannot safely originate Clay parameter/return semantics because annotation-to-Clay mapping would itself become an undeclared semantic authority.

discriminating_test.positive_control: exact qualified symbol + exact source SHA256 + complete annotations + explicit annotation-to-Clay map + explicit expected Clay params/return
negative_controls: runtime annotation mapping that disagrees with explicit Clay parameter contract
runtime return annotation that disagrees with explicit Clay return contract
